product.name: Monoprice Thunderbolt 5 80Gbps 240W Charging 8K Video Compatible with Thunderbolt 4/3 USB4 and USB-C 1.2M 3.9ft
product.description: Monoprice™Thunderbolt 5 Cable, USB-C to USB-C, 80Gbps (120Gbps Bandwidth Boost), 240W Charging, 8K Video, Backward Compatible with Thunderbolt 4/3 and USB4The Monoprice Thunderbolt™ 5 cable connects a current laptop to the gear that makes it a workstation: a Thunderbolt dock, an external graphics enclosure, high-speed storage, and an 8K display. One USB-C cable carries the data, the video, and up to 240W of charging, so a single connection replaces the tangle of separate power, display, and data cables on a desk.At 80Gbps, with Bandwidth Boost to 120Gbps for video, the cable doubles the bandwidth of Thunderbolt 4 and keeps an external GPU or a multi-drive array from being held back by the cable. An integrated e-marker chip lets connected devices negotiate full speed and power automatically, the reversible USB-C connector plugs in right the first time, and the gold-plated connectors and flexible TPE jacket are built for daily use. Certified through Intel's Thunderbolt program and compatible with Thunderbolt 4, Thunderbolt 3, USB4, and USB-C, it works with existing hardware today and the newest Thunderbolt 5 systems as you upgrade, with the professional-grade performance Monoprice prices below premium-brand alternatives, and it is backed by a Monoprice lifetime limited warranty.One cable does it all. Carries Thunderbolt 5 data, 8K video, and up to 240W of charging over a single USB-C connection.Up to 120Gbps bandwidth. 80Gbps bi-directional with Bandwidth Boost to 120Gbps for video, double the 40Gbps of Thunderbolt 4.Charges a workstation laptop. Up to 240W of USB Power Delivery EPR powers and charges a 16-inch-class laptop while it drives a display.8K video ready. Drives multiple 8K or three 4K60 displays over DisplayPort 2.1.Thunderbolt certified. Completes Intel's mandatory Thunderbolt certification for interoperability and reliability.Works with what you own. Compatible with Thunderbolt 4, Thunderbolt 3, USB4, USB 3.0, USB 2.0, and USB-C devices.Built to last. Gold-plated USB4 Type-C connectors and a flexible TPE jacket rated to UL Style 22414, backed by a lifetime limited warranty.Six lengths. From 0.3m at the desk to 1.5m across it. ONE CABLE FOR DATA, 8K VIDEO, AND 240W POWERConnect a dock, an external display, and a charger through a single port instead of running separate cables for each. The cable carries Thunderbolt 5 data, DisplayPort 2.1 video, and USB Power Delivery (USB PD, the standard for negotiated charging over USB-C) on one connection. It supports up to 240 W of charging under the USB PD Extended Power Range (EPR) profile, enough to run and charge a 16-inch-class workstation laptop while it also drives a display. UP TO 120GBPS THUNDERBOLT 5 BANDWIDTHMove large media libraries, run an external GPU, or daisy-chain docks without the cable becoming the bottleneck.The cable provides 80 Gbps of bi-directional, double the 40 Gbps ceiling of Thunderbolt 4 and USB4 Gen 3, and uses Thunderbolt 5 Bandwidth Boost to deliver up to 120 Gbps to a display when video demand is high. 8K VIDEO OVER USB-CDrive one or more high-resolution monitors from the same cable that handles data and power.Over DisplayPort 2.1, the cable supports multiple 8K displays or three 4K @ 60Hz displays, depending on the connected host and dock. ELECTRONICALLY MARKED (E-MARKER) FOR FULL SPEED AND POWERYour devices automatically negotiate the highest safe speed and charging level the moment you plug in. BACKWARDS COMPATIBLE ACROSS THUNDERBOLT AND USBUse it with the gear you already own, not only the newest Thunderbolt 5 hardware.The cable is compatible with Thunderbolt 4, Thunderbolt 3, USB4, USB 3.0, USB 2.0, and USB-C devices. It is reversible, so it connects the right way on the first try. With earlier hardware, data rate and charging step down to the connected device's maximum. DURABLE CONNECTORS AND A FLEXIBLE JACKETConnectors use gold-plated contacts and nickel-plated shells and holds up to repeated plugging and unplugging. The cable jacket is made of a soft, flexible TPE material to make cable runs around your desk easy and tangle free. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1 x Monoprice Thunderbolt 5 USB-C to USB-C cable .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
